top_signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Avantis ETF Cracks Small-Cap Code
top_signals.summary: Eduardo Repetto, CIO of Avantis Investors, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discus the Avantis U.S. Small Cap Value (ticker: AVUV). (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Deadly Earthquake Hits Colombia
top_signals.summary:
A deadly earthquake hit Colombia on Monday morning, toppling buildings, burying people under rubble and causing dozens of deaths in the Pacific region and the central Andes.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Strategy turns 1,690 BTC into $108.6M STRC buyback
top_signals.summary: Strategy sold 1,690 Bitcoin to repurchase STRC shares as its US dollar reserve rose to $4.65 billion and its Bitcoin holdings fell to 840,447 BTC.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
